narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.style: Booming race announcer: big claims, short sentences, delighted by crashes.

sprocket.name: Sprocket
sprocket.style: Young scrappy goblin: fast, cheeky, always halfway through a scheme.

old-smokey.name: Old Smokey
old-smokey.style: Old miner: slow, raspy, every sentence a complaint about the old days.

zapp-gutwrench.name: Zapp Gutwrench
zapp-gutwrench.style: Workshop mechanic: over-caffeinated tinkerer, proud of his own genius.

duchess-vex.name: Duchess Vex
duchess-vex.style: Old money villain: silky, condescending, never raises her voice.

the-hood.name: The Hood
the-hood.style: Low and level: short, ominous, never in a hurry.

ace-spadegrin.name: Ace Spadegrin
ace-spadegrin.style: Card-sharp trickster: there is a grin in every line.

big-grubba.name: Big Grubba
big-grubba.style: Huge and slow: three words at a time, always thinking about food.

knuckles-blau.name: Knuckles Blau
knuckles-blau.style: Rugged bruiser: flat, unimpressed, ready for a fight.

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.style: Pyromaniac: hot tempered, loud, laughs at his own fires.

red-morrigan.name: Red Morrigan
red-morrigan.style: Confident hero: bright, fast, friendly and competitive.
